conf.description: M365 UAL exchange-online csv-file: batch export, AuditData JSON extract, RecordType reconciliation, origin tag, pagination/noise columns stripped

conf.comment: M365 UAL exchange-online, csv-file format (Purview export or Search-UnifiedAuditLog|Export-Csv; backfill/manual-export lane, not live). A filesystem Collector already parsed the CSV wrapper columns; this pipeline's job is Extract-JSON on the AuditData string column, reconciling RecordType (numeric in the portal export, string enum name from the cmdlet) to the same 1/2/50 codes as the json feed, and stripping pagination/PowerShell noise (ResultIndex, ResultCount, and the RunspaceId/IsValid/ObjectState columns the cmdlet path can add) per the map's explicit strip-before-indexing instruction. Per direct.cribl: tag with an origin marker so CSV-sourced events can be reconciled rather than merged with the live feed.

functions.description: decode the AuditData JSON-string column in place into an object
batch rename of straightforward mapped/partial fields to their ECS targets
canonical event time in _time (never @timestamp; Elastic dest maps it)
computed transforms, custom-field routing, and event.dataset
